translations.Det siste året har jeg egentlig brukt AI: Over the past year, I have used AI very minimally. It has mostly served as a sparring partner when discussing ideas and thinking out loud about projects, without me tapping into its full potential for the actual development work.
translations.Det var først høsten 2026 at jeg bestemt: It was not until the autumn of 2026 that I decided to give AI-assisted software development a proper try with a structured methodology. When AI takes care of more of the actual writing, I get more time at both ends of the work: setting up a solid architecture plan at the start, and polishing the user experience details at the end.
translations.Når selve kodeskrivingen går raskere, fl: When the actual coding goes faster, more of the work moves to the beginning and the end. Without clear boundaries upfront and a thorough review at the end, the codebase quickly grows in the wrong direction.
translations.Dette er noe jeg fortsatt utforsker og l: This is something I am still exploring and learning along the way, so the idea is by no means to present this as a rulebook or best practice for AI-assisted development. These are simply habits that have worked well for me so far, and they will certainly change as I learn more and get better at using the tools.
translations.Før jeg skriver kode eller åpner en agen: Before I write any code or open an agent, I map out the data model and technical constraints on paper and in a dedicated AGENTS.md file. A language model knows neither the target audience, quirky target platform requirements, or how lean the package list should be, so those choices must be locked down beforehand.
translations.Se skills og AGENTS.md på GitHub: View skills and AGENTS.md on GitHub
translations.Etter mye egen prøving og feiling landet: After a lot of trial and error, I landed on a rhythm that turned out to be an established method called Spike and Stabilize, described by Dan North. First, I build a quick initial version all the way from database to UI, known as a spike, to see if the idea actually works. Once the core function is in place, I switch to stabilize: clearing away noise, handling edge cases, and getting the code ready for production.
translations.Dan North om Spike and Stabilize: Dan North on Spike and Stabilize
translations.Slank kode og en enkelt kilde: Lean code and a single source
translations.Jo flere filer og lag en modell må hoppe: The more files and layers a model has to jump between, the faster it loses track. I keep the code flat, gather shared data in one place instead of spreading it across multiple files, and clean up structural noise along the way. This keeps the context down to 100 to 200 lines at a time and makes the code easy to understand for both the team and my future self.
translations.Når tempoet øker, blir sikkerhetsnettet: When the pace increases, the safety net becomes even more important. I work in small, frequent commits and keep refactoring separate from new features, so it is always safe to roll back and easy for others to follow the history. Before changes are rolled out, they are verified with automated tests and checks of critical user flows.
translations.På GitHub ligger det mange raske eksperi: On GitHub, there are many quick experiments where I am just testing a tool or an idea on the fly. They work fine as scratchpads. The projects I showcase here, however, are built to withstand a look under the hood, where my own choices drive the architecture, flow, and details.
translations.Det samme gjelder det visuelle. Her i po: The same goes for the visuals. Here in the portfolio, the cards show the actual pages, components, and features I have built, so you see my work. Where AI is the whole point, like the 3D version of me on the front page, it is clearly marked.

translations.VGS Bordtennis startet som et forsøk på: VGS Bordtennis started as an inclusion project for school breaks: building something fun that made it easier for more students to join the table tennis community and stay physically active together. The solution is a real-time system in Node.js for high school tournaments and a live scoreboard on the big screen, paired via a QR code at each table.
translations.Storskjermen i VGS Bordtennis med pallpl: The large screen in VGS Bordtennis with podium placements, live scoreboard, paddles, and BOSS markers.
translations.Storskjermen (/kiosk) viser pallplasser,: The large screen (/kiosk) shows podium placements, ongoing matches, and the full standings live in the cafeteria.
translations.Mobilvisning av turneringsfanen med akti: Mobile view of the tournament tab with active match, standings, and bottom menu featuring Scan QR.
translations.Turnering: Pågående kamp, tabell med utf: Tournament: Ongoing match, standings with challenges against staff, and quick button for QR code at the bottom.
translations.Mobilvisning av kampfanen med oversikt o: Mobile view of the match tab with an overview of the tables in the cafeteria and mingling area.
translations.Match: Sanntidsstatus på bordene (opptat: Match: Real-time status on the tables (busy in a match or available) and who currently holds the table.
translations.Mobilvisning av profilfanen med valgt re: Mobile view of the profile tab with selected paddle, statistics, trophies, and match history.
translations.Profil: Spillerens aktive rekkert, seier: Profile: The player's active paddle, win rate, time at the table, trophies, and trading.
translations.Til daglig jobber jeg med IKT drift og s: On a daily basis, I work with IT operations and support at Nord-Gudbrandsdal VGS. During breaks, we saw that there was already a lot of life and activity around the table tennis tables in the cafeteria, while at the same time a group of students struggled to get into the community and ended up sitting on their phones instead.
translations.Prosjektet startet som et forsøk på inkl: The project started as an attempt at inclusion and to create even more engagement around the tables. As a former video game nerd, I wanted to build something fun that lowered the threshold for joining and reinforced the desire among students to participate actively and physically in a shared activity during breaks.
translations.Lavterskel gjestespill og rask kampflyt: Low-threshold guest play and fast match flow at the table
translations.Hele poenget med løsningen er at elevene: The whole point of the solution is for students to play table tennis rather than standing and tapping on a screen. Therefore, the flow around the table itself is designed so that the phone is only used for a few seconds before and after the match.
translations.Når to spillere skanner QR koden ved sam: When two players scan the QR code at the same table within 45 seconds, they are paired together and the match starts automatically. The phone is put in the pocket while the sets are played, and afterwards one player taps ready-made quick buttons for the result (1-0, 2-0, or 2-1) while the opponent confirms with a single tap.
translations.Gjestespill med poeng på vent: Elever ut: Guest play with points on hold: Students without an account who scan the table go straight into a match as a Guest without filling out a registration form first. They can accumulate up to 3 wins (9 points) on hold, and when they create a profile or log into an existing user afterwards, matches and points are automatically transferred to the account while the temporary guest user is deleted.
translations.Spill mot vinneren og umiddelbar bordfri: Play against the winner and immediate table release: As soon as the first player enters the final result, the table is freed immediately and remembers the winner for 20 minutes. Then two new players can scan the QR code in turn, a new challenger can scan and tap Play against the winner without the winner having to take out their phone, or the previous pair can have a rematch with a single tap. If someone forgets to finish, the table is freed after 12 minutes.
translations.Sesjonsbro mellom kamera og hjemskjerm (: Session bridge between camera and home screen (PWA): Since iOS separates storage between regular Safari and apps on the home screen, the session is synchronized via the manifest so that students stay logged in when they scan the QR code with the mobile camera.
translations.Valideringslogikk mot juks og Boss Fight: Validation logic against cheating and Boss Fight: Legitimate results are approved automatically after 60 seconds, while unnaturally fast matches (under 45 seconds per set) are stopped and flagged to the organizer. The same pair of players cannot lock the standings by playing against each other twice in a row (maximum 2 counting matches per pair per day), and staff can participate as a Boss Fight with a maximum of one counting trophy per staff member per day.
translations.Siden ulike skoler og friminutt har fors: Since different schools and breaks have different needs, the tournament engine supports three setups: King of the Hill (open ladder with 3 points per win and automatic registration at the table where everyone can face each other across the board), playoffs with group stages and knockout rounds, and Swiss-style with fixed rounds where everyone gets to play until the very end.
translations.For å skape samhold på tvers av trinn og: To build unity across grades and classes, the system features dedicated class teams and digital paddles with a local touch from the school and the Innlandet region. Each paddle counts the number of matches, wins, and previous owners. Every third completed tournament, the school switches to a new seasonal pack, and at the end of the school year for the final grade, unlocked paddles are transferred to the school's trophy vault.
translations.Storskjermen i kantina og erfaringer med: The cafeteria large screen and experience with Infoskjermen.no
translations.En av de mest lærerike tekniske utfordri: One of the most educational technical challenges arose when the scoreboard (/kiosk) had to run all school day long through Infoskjermen.no on older Samsung and LG TV screens. On regular mobile phones and PCs, everything worked on the first try, but inside locked TV web browsers, the display behaved completely differently.
translations.I slike TV nettlesere krever systemet et: In such TV browsers, the system requires a physical user click before a <video> is allowed to play. If you call video.play() in an iframe without a click, the browser does not throw an error: the promise simply remains unresolved forever, causing the video to freeze on the first frame. In addition, Chromium throttles timers in cross-domain iframes to whole minute intervals, causing standard second-based polling to be skipped.
translations.24 fps animert WebP fremfor <video>: All: 24 fps animated WebP instead of <video>: All animations on the large screen are created with ffmpeg as 24 fps animated WebP inside a <picture> element with a GIF fallback.
translations.Tre synkroniserte visningslag og TV test: Three synchronized display layers and TV testing: The large screen is first delivered as complete HTML from the server (SSR), upgraded to real-time Socket.IO in modern browsers, and has a dedicated client in pure ES5 (with 3-second polling and measurement of actually elapsed time) for older TV screens. The fallback views can be tested directly in a regular browser with ?mode=es5 and ?mode=ssr.
translations.Diagnosestempel og tidsstyrt dvale: Nede: Diagnostic badge and time-controlled sleep: In the bottom right corner, the screen displays the active mode (LIVE, POLL, ES5, or SSR) and automatically reloads itself when a new version is rolled out. Outside of school hours, the large screen goes into sleep mode and wakes up again at the start of the next school day.
translations.Løsningen er bygget i Node.js med inneby: The solution is built in Node.js with built-in node:sqlite in WAL mode and only 5 npm packages (express, socket.io, dotenv, qrcode, and web-push). Multiple schools run separately on the same instance via school_id in the database and dedicated Socket.IO rooms, inside a closed Docker container on Fly.io in Stockholm with fixed persistent storage, CalVer versioning, and automatic backup (VACUUM INTO) on new releases. Before rollout, the system was stress-tested with 100 concurrent players across two schools without errors.
translations.Fordi løsningen brukes av skoleelever, e: Because the solution is used by students, privacy (GDPR Article 25) is built right into the data model. As soon as a school organizer verifies a student, temporary names and email addresses are permanently deleted with NULL values in the database, while unverified data is automatically purged after 14 days and empty guest sessions after 24 hours. Only a one-way HMAC-SHA256 hash is kept for login, students can delete their own accounts on the spot, and organizers can generate an anonymized activity report for the school featuring weekly pulse, daily rhythms, and timelines, with A4 PDFs and Excel files generated without external packages.

translations.Da Kim og jeg skulle forme merkevaren og: When Kim and I shaped the brand and messaging for Ember Booking, the work started by defining our ideal customer, and just as importantly, who we choose not to target for now. Our target audience consists of busy owners of small and medium-sized businesses who juggle many tasks and want to spend as little time as possible on administration and as much time as possible on their customers, campaigns, and operations.
translations.To konkrete kundeprofiler og smertepunkt: Two concrete customer profiles and pain points guided the positioning, copywriting, and structure of the website:
translations.Ronny (Honndalen Gym og Sauna): Driver t: Ronny (Honndalen Gym and Sauna): Runs a fitness studio, group classes, and saunas. Before Ember, he spent up to a full workday each month pulling reports, cross-checking Vipps payments in Excel, and entering accounting vouchers manually into Tripletex.
translations.Deving (ATV utleie og naturopplevelser p: Deving (ATV rental and nature adventures on the west coast): Frustrated with established rental systems (such as Periode.no, Gibbs, and Sharefox) that market themselves as simple, but in practice require lengthy training and are packed with features the business does not need.
translations.Posisjonering og budskap: Tre løfter ute: Positioning and messaging: Three promises without fluff
translations.Innsikten fra bedriftseierne gjorde det: Insights from business owners made it easy to strip away vague marketing jargon. When someone asks what sets Ember Booking apart from older systems, our positioning and website copy boil down to three concrete promises:
translations.Vipps registrering på sekunder uten lang: Vipps registration in seconds without long forms: Many systems force guests to fill out lengthy forms and create passwords just to book an appointment. With Vipps or card payments (Stripe and PayPal), the customer is registered and paid in seconds.
translations.Ferdig avstemt regnskap: Alle transaksjo: Fully reconciled accounting: All transactions are automatically reconciled against Tripletex and Fiken, and the system sends out SMS and email confirmations for every reservation. Business owners only need to review the numbers instead of doing manual bookkeeping.
translations.Klar til bruk på en dag uten opplæringsk: Ready to use in a day with no training courses: The system only contains the functionality rental businesses actually use in their daily operations, avoiding redundant modules that make setup cumbersome.
translations.Informasjonsarkitektur og tillitsreisen: Information architecture and the trust journey on emberbooking.no
translations.Selve oppbyggingen av emberbooking.no (b: The structure of emberbooking.no, built in Next.js 16, is designed to answer the questions and doubts a business owner has before taking the plunge and switching systems:
translations.Over folden (Hero): Tydelig verdiforslag: Above the fold (Hero): A clear value proposition ("One booking system for all your resources"), a brief explanation of how booking, payment, and accounting connect, a primary call to action, and low friction ("No lock-in period").
translations.Hvorfor Ember (3 raske kort under Hero):: Why Ember (3 quick cards below the Hero): Shows the difference from heavy competitors at a glance with fast Vipps checkout, targeted features, and an automated workday.
translations.Fra smertepunkt til løsning: Setter førs: From pain point to solution: First puts words to the frustration of Excel sheets, manual exports and imports, and clunky systems, before presenting the solution featuring automated accounting, fast payment, and resource management.
translations.Bruksområder og sosial tillit (Social Pr: Use cases and social proof: Industry cards (such as saunas with planned heater and lighting control, fitness centers, and ATV and car rentals) and customer stories from real pilot customers saving 5 to 7 hours a month are naturally distributed down the page.
translations.Åpne priser og FAQ: Tydelige pakker uten: Transparent pricing and FAQ: Clear packages with no hidden costs and answers to the most common questions about accounting integration, setup, and lock-in periods, followed by a final call to action.
translations.Kim og jeg tar jevnlige statusmøter der: Kim and I hold regular status meetings to review the company's direction, set strategy, and distribute tasks. It also controls the user interface, displays projects on the screen, pulls up the CV when needed, and sticks strictly to structured data sources.
translations.Praktiske bruksområder utenfor en portef: Practical use cases outside of a portfolio
translations.Tanken bak oppsettet var å teste hvor næ: The idea behind the setup was to test how close you can get to a normal spoken conversation on the web when the model speaks with a natural voice, controls what you see on the screen, and at the same time sticks strictly to approved facts.
translations.Samme oppsett har tydelig nytteverdi i a: The same setup has clear value in other industries: in healthcare, it can give elderly people and patients calm verbal guidance through forms and preparations; in schools, students can practice speaking in safe surroundings; and in customer service, companies can help users visually through an issue without the model making up its own answers.
translations.Stemmen er klonet fra et 17 sekunders ly: The voice is cloned from a 17-second audio recording and streamed in real time over SSE from /api/chat. When audio is enabled, the chat bubble waits to appear until the first audio chunk actually starts playing in the Web Audio API, so text, voice, and lip movements line up.
translations.Tale til tekst (/api/transcribe): Besøke: Speech-to-text (/api/transcribe): Visitors can speak directly into the microphone in the chat, supported by a custom glossary for project names and technical terms.
translations.Streng faktaforankring: Systemprompten b: Strict factual grounding: The system prompt is built dynamically from the same data source as the website itself (projects.ts and portfolio.ts), with clear boundaries for what the model should answer and when it should refer users to email.

translations.Jeg har bygget mine egne rammer, såkalte: I have built my own frameworks, so-called skills, which are openly available at github.com/yosang/skills. These are rules that code agents must follow in every project I work on, focusing on lean architecture, short contexts, calm interfaces, and natural language.
translations.Hvorfor jeg samlet reglene i et eget rep: Why I gathered the rules in a dedicated repository
translations.Da jeg høsten 2026 gikk inn for å bruke: When I started using AI-assisted software development more systematically in the autumn of 2026, I quickly noticed that quality stands and falls on the frameworks you set in advance. Without fixed limitations, language models tend to add unnecessary abstractions, defensive code that hides errors, and visual noise.
translations.Ved å samle reglene i et eget repo som f: By gathering the rules in a dedicated repository that follows the Agent Skills standard (compatible with Claude Code, Cursor, Antigravity, and Gemini CLI), I can apply the same requirements to every new project.
translations.Repoet er delt inn i tre moduler slik at: The repository is divided into three modules so that each task only loads the rules actually needed:
translations.ui-craft: Bygger på Matt D. Smiths 3P ra: ui-craft: Built on Matt D. Smith's 3P framework (Purpose, Principles, Personality) and the 60-30-10 color rule. Cuts out random glow effects and oversized cards in favor of matte surfaces, calm OKLCH colors, fluid typography (Utopia.fyi), and an 8pt spacing system.
translations.lean-architecture: Holder konteksten kor: lean-architecture: Keeps the context short and requires planning before code. Focuses on a single data source, deleting dead code, small commits, and Dan North's Spike and Stabilize.
translations.natural-copy: Fjerner typiske AI uvaner: natural-copy: Removes typical AI habits in both Norwegian and English text, such as dashes, unnecessary hyphens, empty clichés, and stiff translations of technical terms.
translations.Her er også skills repoet mitt med faste: Here is also my skills repository, containing fixed rules for architecture, design, and language when I use AI.

translations.MedCare Clinical ble bygget over fem uke: MedCare Clinical was built over five weeks as the final exam project for the two-year backend development program at Noroff. The assignment was to plan, model, and develop a complete clinic appointment booking system in C# and .NET 9 with MySQL and a corresponding React client.
translations.Uke 1: Normalisering (3NF), skjemasjekk: Week 1: Normalization (3NF), schema verification, and CI from day one
translations.Før jeg skrev en eneste linje C#, brukte: Before writing a single line of C#, I spent the first few days reviewing the requirements specification, refreshing my knowledge of normalization, and drawing the ER diagram in third normal form (3NF). Among other things, I separated cities, categories, and statuses into their own tables linked to clinics and appointments.
translations.Da modellene og relasjonene var satt opp: Once the models and relations were set up in Entity Framework Core, I wanted to be certain that the C# code produced the exact database structure I had planned. I ran mysqldump from MySQL and imported the schema back into dbdiagram.io to verify that tables, foreign keys, and unique constraints matched the ER diagram.
translations.GlobalExceptionHandler: Satte opp sentra: GlobalExceptionHandler: Set up centralized error handling early in week 1 so the service layer could avoid repetitive try/catch blocks in every method.
translations.Swagger med XML dokumentasjon: Konfigure: Swagger with XML documentation: Configured Swagger at /doc with XML comments, example data, and response codes for every endpoint.
translations.GitHub Actions CI: La inn automatisk byg: GitHub Actions CI: Added automatic build verification on every push right from the start, ensuring no commit could silently break the build process.
translations.Uke 2: Egne mappere fremfor AutoMapper o: Week 2: Custom mappers instead of AutoMapper and the discovery with .Select and .Include
translations.Etter hvert som antallet entiteter og DT: As the number of entities and DTO objects grew, manual mapping in the service layer became cluttered. I considered libraries like AutoMapper and Mapperly, but chose to write custom extension methods in C# (such as ToAppointmentWithDetailsDTO and ToClinicDTO) along with an UpdateWith helper method for partial updates. This kept the services readable without adding extra packages.
translations.Denne oppryddingen viste en viktig detal: This cleanup revealed an important detail about how EF Core builds SQL: as long as the mapping was placed directly inside a .Select(a => new DTO { Doctor = ... }) expression, EF Core understood that it needed to fetch the Doctor relation automatically. When I switched to .Select(a => a.ToAppointmentWithDetailsDTO()), EF Core could no longer read the expression tree and threw an error because related data was missing. The solution was to add explicit .Include() calls to the queries.
translations.Samme uke endret jeg fødselsnummer (Nati: That same week, I changed the national identity number property from an integer to an 11 character string, since Norwegian ID numbers can start with 0 and are never used for mathematical calculations.
translations.Overlappende legetimer (tegnet på papir): Overlapping doctor appointments (sketched on paper) and duplicate checks for guests
translations.For å hindre dobbeltbooking la jeg først: To prevent double booking, I initially added composite unique indexes in the database on DoctorId + AppointmentDate and PatientId + AppointmentDate. During testing, I discovered that the index only stopped two appointments starting at the exact same minute, but failed to block a new booking at 10:15 if the doctor already had a 30 minute appointment from 10:00 to 10:30.
translations.Jeg måtte sette meg ned med penn og papi: I had to sit down with pen and paper to map out the timelines to be 100 percent sure the date validation caught all variations of overlaps, both for new bookings and when a registered patient modifies an existing appointment.
translations.Gjenbruk av pasientprofil ved gjestebook: Reusing patient profiles for guest bookings: Patients without an account can book appointments using their name, date of birth, phone number, and email. If the same person books again later or creates a full user account, the backend reuses and upgrades the existing patient row instead of creating duplicates.
translations.Soft delete ved avbestilling: Avbestilte: Soft delete on cancellation: Cancelled appointments are kept in the database with a status for historical records without blocking that time slot for new patients.
translations.Uke 4 og 5: Fra Zustand til TanStack Que: Weeks 4 and 5: From Zustand to TanStack Query, in-memory JWT, and RBAC
translations.I starten av arbeidet med frontenden bru: Early in the frontend development, I used Zustand for everything, including fetching lists of doctors and appointments. This resulted in a lot of repetitive code and unnecessary useEffect calls. Even though I was behind schedule following a bout of flu midway through the project, I decided to refactor data fetching to TanStack Query (using useQuery, useMutation, and useInfiniteQuery with backend pagination), while keeping only pure client state like the active token and theme in Zustand.
translations.Kortlivet Access Token i minnet + httpOn: Short-lived access token in memory plus httpOnly refresh cookie: Access tokens (lasting 1 to 15 minutes) are kept exclusively in memory. When a protected endpoint responds with a 401, the client automatically calls POST /api/Auth/refresh with an httpOnly cookie (lasting 7 days) and renews access without the user noticing.
translations.Rollebasert tilgangskontroll (RBAC): For: Role-Based Access Control (RBAC): To prevent regular logged-in patients from modifying lookup tables such as clinics, cities, and specialties, I added a dedicated Role table (Patient and Admin) and locked down write endpoints with [Authorize(Roles = "Admin")].
translations.Innspurt og optimalisering: Brukte react: Final push and optimization: Used react-scan to eliminate unnecessary UI re-renders, consolidated duplicate JWT settings into JWTTokenValidationParameters, moved CORS settings out to appsettings.json, and shifted all sorting and filtering of appointments from the frontend table over to the backend.

translations.Cinemorra er en filmkatalog og utlånsløs: Cinemorra is a movie catalog and rental system built as a frontend assignment at Noroff. The project focuses on route structure in the Next.js App Router, Server Actions, form validation, and automated component tests.
translations.Rutestruktur i Next.js App Router: Route structure in the Next.js App Router
translations.Applikasjonen er delt inn i tydelige rut: The application is divided into clear route groups within the Next.js App Router: an open section ((home)) where visitors can explore genres, search the catalog, watch trailers, and read reviews, and a protected admin panel ((dashboard)/admin) for adding, editing, and deleting movies.
Access control is handled in middleware.ts, and each route has dedicated loading and error states to keep transitions and error handling clean in the user interface.
translations.Innlogging og endringer i filmkatalogen: Authentication and changes to the movie catalog run through Next.js Server Actions, while client state such as filters, rental status, and theme selection (light and dark mode) is managed with Zustand.
translations.Komponenttester: Sentrale visninger og i: Component tests: Key views and user interactions are tested using Jest and React Testing Library.
translations.Accessibility: Koden sjekkes med eslint-: Accessibility: Code is checked with eslint-plugin-jsx-a11y, using semantic form elements and full keyboard support.
translations.Til slutt finner du Cinemorra, en filmka: Finally, we have Cinemorra, a movie catalog with rental features and a custom admin panel built in Next.js and TypeScript.
translations.Milepæl fra produksjon: Evaluering og ti: Production milestone: Evaluation and adjustments on day 2
translations.Allerede på dag 2 i drift ved Nord-Gudbr: Already by day 2 in operation at Nord-Gudbrandsdal VGS, the production data from the activity report gave a clear picture of how students were actually using the app in the cafeteria. From 4 matches during lunch on day 1, activity jumped to 21 completed matches before 13:20 on day 2 on a single table, with 28 registered profiles (plus guest sessions up to racket number 33) and 15 different players with official matches.
translations.Tidsstemplene viste faste bølger gjennom: The timestamps showed consistent waves throughout the school day: a quick round before classes started at 08:08, a morning session, and 9 consecutive matches over 72 minutes during the lunch break with zero downtime at the table. The time from one match ending to the next pair starting dropped to between 12 and 38 seconds, and when there was a queue, students naturally chose quick 1-set matches lasting 3 to 4 minutes before switching to best-of-3 sets when things quieted down. The rules against table monopolies (a maximum of 2 official matches per pair per day and rotating opponents) kicked in automatically 4 times during the day and moved extra games to free play, leaving three students tied at the top of the leaderboard.
translations.Basert på observasjonene fra de to først: Based on observations from the first two days, we rolled out three targeted updates the same day to stay ahead of typical school environment challenges:
translations.Timeplanstyring for bordene i skoletiden: Schedule management for tables during school hours: To prevent matches from spilling over into class time when the bell rings, organizers can now set fixed time windows for breaks and lunch when the tables are open for match starts, combined with temporary unlocks for study halls or gym class.
translations.Kallenavnmoderering med 24 timers varsel: Nickname moderation with a 24-hour notice: Since teenagers are quick to find creative wordplay that bypasses standard word filters on the big screen, organizers were given tools to change inappropriate nicknames directly without deleting a player's points. The student can still log in with their old nickname, sees a notice for 24 hours explaining why the name was changed, and is blocked from switching back to the banned name.
translations.Motstanderbekreftelse ved modusbytte i k: Opponent confirmation for match mode switching: To prevent a player from single-handedly switching a ranked match to free play when they are losing, changing between tournament and free play modes now requires confirmation from the opponent before the result can be submitted. In case of a disagreement over the result, the match quietly goes to conflict resolution in the organizer panel without blocking the table for the next pair.
translations.Kort fortalt: denne porteføljen har inge: In short: this portfolio has no user accounts, no tracking cookies, and no database storing what you type or say in the chat. Here is a clear overview of what happens under the hood.
translations.sessionStorage (ai-twin-chat): Husker på: sessionStorage (ai-twin-chat): Remembers your active chat thread while you click between pages in the same tab. Automatically deleted when you close the tab.
translations.For å beskytte API kvoten mot automatise: To protect the API quota from automated spam, the server keeps a simple counter per IP address in volatile memory (RAM) that resets continuously. IP addresses are never written to disk or any database.
translations.Når du sender en melding, bruker mikrofo: When you send a message, use the microphone, or enable audio in the chat, your request is sent encrypted (HTTPS) to the Google Gemini API to generate text replies, transcribe speech to text, and synthesize voice. Every call for text replies, speech to text, and voice synthesis is sent with storage disabled (store: false).
translations.Enten skrev du inn feil URL, eller så ra: Either you typed the wrong URL, or neither I nor my model got around to building this page yet.
translations.Hvordan sikrer du chatten mot prompt inj: How do you secure the chat against prompt injection?
translations.Sikkerhet og prompt injection når AI møt: Security and prompt injection when AI faces users
translations.Å bruke AI som sparringspartner på egen: Using AI as a sparring partner on your own machine is straightforward, but once a language model is wired to a public input field and allowed to trigger browser navigation, new attack surfaces appear. During a security review of the 3D chat on this site, two concrete weaknesses showed up in the initial draft: viewport metadata from the browser was interpolated unfiltered into the system instruction, and the [GO:...] navigation tag passed its value to the router without a whitelist.
translations.En språkmodell jobber ut fra sannsynligh: A language model works on probability and can never stand alone as access control. Instead, security sits in three fixed layers of ordinary code around the model:
translations.Skille instruks og brukerdata: Systemins: Separating instructions from user data: The system instruction is built strictly from static files on the server. Everything arriving from the browser or microphone is stripped of control tags and wrapped inside dedicated XML fences (<untrusted_visitor_input> and <viewport_state>), while conversation history is sent as typed role steps in the API so nobody can spoof earlier replies in the thread.
translations.Hviteliste i kode fremfor tillit til mod: Code whitelists instead of trusting model output: The model never gets to pick arbitrary URLs or file paths. Tags like [GO:...] and [TOUR:...] are validated against fixed whitelists in TypeScript on both server and client so external addresses never reach the router. The [FILE:cv] attachment points only to a static PDF when the visitor actually asked for a resume.
translations.Null lagring og faste kvoter: Alle kall: Zero retention and fixed quotas: Every call to Gemini (text replies, voice synthesis, and speech to text) is sent with storage disabled (store: false), paired with Origin and Sec-Fetch-Site checks, payload caps, and per-minute and daily rate limits in memory.
translations.Les den tekniske gjennomgangen i caset o: Read the technical breakdown in the Interactive Portfolio case study
translations.Her var strategien helt motsatt. Jeg gjo: Here the strategy was completely opposite. I did the groundwork myself, created assets in Figma, and built the design system by hand. I only used AI at the very end to catch inconsistencies and syntax errors before rollout.
translations.Arkitektur og sikkerhet: Delt 3D modell: Architecture and security: Shared 3D model with 20 blendshapes running in a dedicated OffscreenCanvas Web Worker at 60 fps, paired with real-time TTS, speech to text, and prompt injection defenses.
translations.Delt 3D modell i egen Web Worker på 60 f: Shared 3D model in a dedicated Web Worker at 60 fps
translations.Avataren er en 3D skanning av meg med 20: The avatar is a 3D scan of me with 20 blendshapes for lip sync, blinking, and facial expressions, combined with skeletal neck and head tracking. So the 3D view never blocks the main thread or slows down scrolling, the canvas runs inside a dedicated OffscreenCanvas Web Worker (avatar.worker.ts).
translations.En og samme WebGL og Worker instans flyt: A single shared WebGL and Worker instance moves directly via a DOM portal between the front-page hero, the floating corner dock, and the fullscreen studio (/chat), loading the 3D model only once in memory. Three.js boots on first interaction and pauses automatically via IntersectionObserver whenever the avatar leaves the viewport.
translations.Synkronisert stemmekloning og tale til t: Synchronized voice cloning and speech to text
translations.Vernet mot prompt injection: Funn og til: Defending against prompt injection: Findings and fixes from a security audit
translations.Når en språkmodell får sende ut kontroll: When a language model can emit control tags that drive the user interface ([TOUR:<slug>], [GO:<path>], and [FILE:cv]), every input from the browser has to be treated as untrusted. During a thorough security audit of the codebase, three concrete weaknesses surfaced in the initial version: client viewport metadata (body.page) was interpolated directly into the system instruction without sanitization, the [GO:...] navigation tag lacked the whitelist that [TOUR:...] had, and voice synthesis missed an explicit store: false flag.
translations.Siden en språkmodell alltid kan gjøre fe: Because a language model can always make mistakes or face manipulation attempts, I moved the security boundaries into deterministic TypeScript code inside a shared guard module (apiGuard.ts) across both endpoints:
translations.Kanalseparasjon og XML gjerder: Systemin: Channel separation and XML fences: The system instruction is assembled strictly from static server files. Client messages and viewport state are stripped of control tags and line breaks, then wrapped inside <untrusted_visitor_input> and <viewport_state> with a closing security rule at the bottom of the prompt. Audio clips in /api/transcribe are likewise locked to verbatim transcription so spoken input is never executed as commands.
translations.Låste samtaleroller og null lagring (sto: Locked conversation roles and zero retention (store: false): Conversation history is passed as typed user_input and model_output steps in the Gemini Interactions API instead of concatenated text, preventing turn spoofing in the thread. Every call for chat, voice, and speech to text runs with store: false.
translations.Dobbel hvitelisting av handlinger: [GO:<: Dual action whitelisting: [GO:<path>] is validated against a fixed whitelist of internal routes on both server and client before router.push runs, ensuring external URLs can never open. [FILE:cv] points to a static PDF file and is only emitted when the visitor message actually asks for a CV or resume.
translations.Misbruksvern og kostnadstak: Felles sjek: Abuse protection and cost caps: Shared verification of Sec-Fetch-Site, exact Origin, and client header, paired with request size limits and per-minute and daily quotas in RAM.
